cv:
חמד נולד בשנת 1932. גדל בשבט אל-צנעא בנגב.

ביום 14.07.1958 נרצח חמד ביריות מסתננים שהגיעו משטח ירדן.

בן 26 במותו.
cvEn:
Hemed Abu-Mashish was born in 1932. He grew up in the Al-Sana'a tribe in the Negev.

On 14 July 1958, Hemed was shot and killed by infiltrators who had crossed from Jordanian territory.

He was 26 years old at the time of his death.
